title: Capyx - Mainframe - Application Life Cycle Management
description:
We are looking for an experienced Mainframe Application Life Cycle Management Specialist to join a strategic project with a leading organisation in Belgium.
The role is primarily focused on Mainframe application development, deployment and lifecycle management. The organisation uses Kobee as its Application Life Cycle Management platform, but previous Kobee experience is not required.
We are therefore particularly interested in candidates with a strong background in Mainframe environments, application lifecycle management, JCL, release management, deployment processes and Mainframe development tooling, who are willing to learn Kobee.

Your responsibilities

  • Provide technical support to Mainframe application developers.
  • Analyse and resolve issues related to Mainframe application development and lifecycle management.
  • Support application build, packaging, deployment and release processes.
  • Develop, maintain and troubleshoot JCL used in application lifecycle processes.
  • Support the installation, configuration and upgrade of the Application Life Cycle Management environment.
  • Automate and optimise Mainframe development and deployment processes.
  • Work closely with Mainframe developers, application teams and infrastructure teams.
  • Analyse technical issues across the application lifecycle and identify appropriate solutions.
  • Improve and standardise development, testing and deployment processes.
  • Contribute to the evolution of the Mainframe ALM / DevOps environment.
  • Develop expertise in the organisation's ALM tooling, including Kobee.
We are looking for a hands-on Mainframe professional with solid experience in Mainframe application development and/or Application Life Cycle Management.
Essential experience:
  • Several years of professional experience in a Mainframe environment.
  • Strong understanding of Mainframe application development and deployment processes.
  • Good knowledge of JCL and experience creating, maintaining and troubleshooting JCL scripts.
  • Experience with Mainframe application lifecycle, release or deployment management.
  • Experience working with Mainframe development or change-management tools.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to work closely with developers and technical teams.
  • Comfortable learning new technical tools and environments.
Experience with technologies such as:
  • JCL, Cobol,CICS, DB2, IMS, z/OS, TSO/ISPF
  • Mainframe batch processing
  • Mainframe application deployment and release processes
  • Knowledge of Java and Tomcat is a plus.
  • Previous Kobee experience is not mandatory.
  • Kobee is a specialised Application Life Cycle Management solution used in the organisation's Mainframe environment. The successful candidate will receive the opportunity to develop expertise in Kobee.
  • Candidates with strong Mainframe ALM / DevOps experience using other tools 
  • You are an experienced Mainframe professional who understands how applications are developed, maintained, tested, packaged and deployed in a Mainframe environment.
  • You enjoy troubleshooting complex technical issues, improving processes and working closely with development teams.
  • You do not necessarily need to know Kobee. What matters most is your Mainframe expertise, JCL knowledge and understanding of application lifecycle and deployment processes.

description:
Onze klant gelegen in Sint-Truiden is gespecialiseerd in HVAC-montage en technieken. Ze zijn niet een doorsnee chauffagist, maar staan voor duurzaamheid en innovatie. 's Morgens komen de monteurs samen in Sint-Truiden en vertrekken ze naar de verschillende werven, de techniekers vertrekken rechtstreeks van thuis met een camionette.

title: Order picker - night shift - English allowed!
description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

  • Making orders based on order lists
  • Preparing completed orders for shipment
  • Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks

You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

  • Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
  • Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
  • Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
  • Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

title: Multi-skilled maintenance technician - English is allowed!
description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

  • Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
  • Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
  • Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
  • Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
  • Supervise external contractors and service providers

You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

  • Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
  • Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
  • Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
  • Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
  • Already living in Belgium, preferably in the greater area of Oostkamp

Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not required, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC...

title: Warehouse job: order picker in day shift
description:
Are you already familiar with orderpicking and logistics? And are you looking for a stable and physically engaging role with job security? And do you like great hours to get a good work-life balance? Then this is an excellent opportunity for you!

For a large and growing logistics in Oostkamp specialised in frozen goods, we're looking for an orderpicker to join the day shift team in the freezer warehouse. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an orderpicker, you play a crucial part in the company’s logistical process. You work in the freezer every day to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

  • Making orders based on order lists
  • Preparing completed orders for shipment
  • Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks

You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

  • Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
  • Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
  • Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

title: Country Manager - eMobility - BeLux
description:
Our client is a European tech group operating across mobility and renewable energy, with several complementary businesses spanning digital media, training, e-commerce, and software.The role focuses on their EV charging platform, a scale-up offering a leading consumer app, a roaming charging solution used across Europe, and a growing B2B SaaS platform for corporate fleets.As part of their international expansion, they are now appointing a Country Manager to build and lead the BeLux market.


Jobomschrijving

As Country Manager, your main responsibilities will be to :

Shape & own the BeLux market strategy

  • Define the market vision and priorities for Belgium & Luxembourg, adapting the global framework to local realities.
  • Build a deep understanding of drivers, barriers, competitors, and user/company behaviors to inform strategic decisions.
  • Identify high-impact growth levers across B2C and B2B.



Accelerate B2C adoption & engagement

  • Boost usage of the mobile app and charging access solution through creative, locally relevant activation.
  • Work with Marketing on targeted campaigns and growth experiments; ensure seamless onboarding with Customer Success.
  • Influence product developments by sharing market insights and feature needs with Product & Tech.



Drive B2B development & support fleet electrification

  • Analyze fleet maturity and corporate charging needs to position the B2B SaaS offer effectively.
  • Partner with Marketing & Sales to build a solid lead generation engine and qualify opportunities.
  • Secure customer satisfaction and long-term usage through close collaboration with Customer Success and B2B Ops.



Turn strategy into execution & measurable results

  • Own the BeLux KPIs and P&L: monitor performance, detect weak signals, and propose data-backed improvements.
  • Deploy clear action plans and ensure cross-functional alignment for efficient execution.
  • Be the operational link between market needs and central teams (Sales, Product, Tech, Marketing, CS).



Build and represent the brand in the local ecosystem

  • Become the face of the company in the BeLux market: attend events, engage communities, and expand visibility.
  • Develop partnerships with charging networks, installers, service providers, driver associations, and corporate stakeholders.
  • Conduct initial discovery visits with prospects, validate opportunities, and coordinate handovers to internal Business Developers.



Prepare the ground for future local expansion

  • Identify organizational needs as the market grows and contribute to planning a future local team (Sales, Marketing, etc.).
  • Ensure continuous feedback loops to refine positioning, operations, and product-market fit.

The successful candidate will have the following qualities:

  • Relevant experience in market development / new market launch / acceleration (ideally in SaaS, digital products, mobility, energy)
  • Proven ability to adapt a global strategy to local dynamics and deliver measurable growth.
  • Data-driven: confident with KPIs, dashboards, CRM, and translating field insights into action.
  • Strong partnership-building mindset with companies, associations, and institutional stakeholders.
  • Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and autonomous, with excellent cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Deep understanding of BeLux cultural and business context; EV ecosystem knowledge is a plus.
  • Fluent in Dutch and English.

title: Huishoudhulp thuiszorg - regio Olen (deeltijds)
description:
Familiehulp ondersteunt mensen in hun dagelijks leven, met aandacht voor zorg, welzijn, huishouden en schoonmaak.

 

Als huishoudhulp / poetshulp in de thuiszorg ondersteun je mensen met een zorgbehoefte.

Je helpt hen voornamelijk met huishoudelijke taken zodat zij comfortabel thuis kunnen blijven wonen.

De klant is altijd thuis als jij er bent en je werkt samen met collega's huishoudhulpen en verzorgenden in een zorgteam.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Het schoonmaken en poetsen van de woning.
  • Af en toe de was en strijk .
  • Een luisterend oor en aandacht voor het welzijn van je klant.
  • Het signaleren van noden of veranderingen aan je collega's wanneer dat nodig is.

Je krijgt een contract van bepaalde duur van 6 maanden. Nadien is er kans op een vast contract.  

Je werkt tussen 20 en 38 uur per week. Het uurrooster is bespreekbaar, maar je kan zeker werken op dinsdagvoormiddag. 

  • Geen ervaring of diploma nodig.
  • Je hebt een hart voor mensen en haalt voldoening uit huishoudelijke hulp, poetsen en schoonmaken bij klanten thuis.
  • Je houdt van sociaal contact, maar werkt ook graag zelfstandig.
  • Je werkt stipt en overlegt vlot met je klant en het zorgteam.
  • Je bent betrouwbaar en hebt respect voor de privacy van je klanten.

  • Je beschikt over eigen vervoer (elektrische fiets, bromfiets, auto).

title: 🏠Persoonsbegeleider
description:
Ben je op zoek naar een job met zin(geving)?

Ben jij die zorgzame woonbegeleider (voltijds of 4/5 ) die zorg wil dragen voor volwassenen met een Niet Aangeboren Hersenletsel met al dan niet bijkomende fysieke en/of psychische zorgvragen.

  • Je staat dagelijks in voor de zorg van het Algemeen Dagelijks Leven,(ADL) zoals je thuis zou doen, maar dan aangepast aan de zorgvraag van de bewoners, gaande van begeleiden bij ontbijt-tot en met de avondsituatie , dit binnen shiften van 7u30 /8.00 per dag. Je werkt binnen een variabel uurrooster tussen 07:00-21:00 , wat maandelijks wordt vastgeklikt.
  • Naast de lichamelijke zorgvragen, bied je kortdurende activiteiten aan , aangepast aan de vraag van de bewoners ( wandeling, krant voorlezen, gezelschapsspel, creatief aan de slag gaan ...) . Je volgt hierin het tempo van de bewoner en straalt rust uit.
  • Je werkt samen met 2 andere collega's op de dienst en wordt logistiek ondersteund door onderhoudsdienst en thuiszorgdiensten. Vanaf 20:45 start de actieve nachtdienst voor de nachtondersteuning die overneemt. Er staat dus 1 medewerker per verdiep: op de eerste verdieping wonen 8 personen met een meer fysieke beperking, op de bovenverdieping wonen 14 bewoners met die iets mobieler zijn en een 8-tal personen die wat meer zelfredzaam zijn.
  • Je werkt 1 WE /2 ( zaterdag en zondag) en je ontvangt hiervoor bijzondere prestaties ( +20% op zaterdagen, +50% op feestdagen , +100% op zondagen).
  • Na een inwerkperiode van een aantal maanden, sta je via de opmaak en opvolging van het pedagogisch handelingsplan in voor de pedagogische opvolging van een aantal bewoners die je intensiever opvolgt naar te realiseren doelstellingen.
  • Naast de opvolging van het pedagogisch handelingsplan, verricht je minimale administratieve opvolging via het intern communicatieplatform (observatie, maaltijdbestellingen, ...)

Zoek je een job met zingeving binnen het landelijke Lennik waarbinnen jij het verschil kan maken? Solliciteer dan snel voor dit vervangingscontract . Het contract loopt af wanneer de medewerker terugkomt uit ziekte.

Wil jij eens proeven van deze werking? solliciteer dan snel!

Ben jij flexibel? ben je sterk in communicatie?

Kan je zelfstandig werken, maar ben je ook sterk in samenwerken, dan ben jij met een hart en met een diploma in de zorg , de geknipte kandidaat.

title: Business Analyst  & Transformation Project lead
description:
Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

  • Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
  • Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
  • Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
  • Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.

Business Process Improvement

  • Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
  • Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
  • Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.

Requirements Analysis

  • Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
  • Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
  • Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
  • Solution Development

Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

  • Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
  • Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.

Commercial & Supplier Management

  • Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
  • Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
  • Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.

 

Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
  • Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
  • Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.
  • Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
  • Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
  • Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
  • Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
  • Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
  • Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

title: Teamleader tankstation
description:
Ben je op zoek naar een functie als verantwoordelijke in de verkoop met een wisselende uurrooster? Hou je van een job met voldoende uitdaging? En passen shiften perfect binnen jouw privéleven? Dan is deze vacature precies wat je zoekt!

Binnen ons team werken verschillende teamleaders, elk met hun eigen expertise.

Wat mag je zoal verwachten van het takenpakket?

  • Je ondersteunt de manager van het station waar nodig
  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de shop, administratie of het restaurant (in kleinere stations combineer je deze taken)
  • Je staat in voor facturatie, evaluatiegesprekken, personeelsplanning, opleiding van nieuwe collega’s, bestellingen en nog veel meer

Het gaat om een voltijdse functie van 36 uur per week, met uren die flexibel ingepland worden. Je werkt tussen 04u30 (ochtendshift) en 22u15 (avondshift), afwisselend in dag-, vroege en late diensten. Uiteraard ontvang je je uurrooster steeds tijdig.

title: Customer Service Representative English
description:
You will support the Customer Service team with tasks such as order entry, stock assignment, requests of certificates, etc.

 As you will progress in your training, the responsibilities can be expanded to direct customer support and coordination of the full order to cash process for a selected amount of customers.

  • Act as a key point of contact for assigned customers and provide professional and timely support.

  • Knowledge of Russian is an additional asset, but is not required.
  • You work accurately, take ownership and enjoy contributing to a collaborative team environment.

description:
Heb jij een passie voor mensen en wil je hen een geweldige ervaring bieden? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou als gastheer of gastvrouw voor onze elektronische speelzaal.
Jij bent het eerste contactpunt voor onze klanten en creëert met jouw positieve uitstraling en klantgerichte benadering een warme sfeer waarin bezoekers zich direct welkom voelen.

 

Voornaamste taken

  • Je begroet klanten met een glimlach, begeleidt hen bij hun eerste stappen in de speelzaal en zorgt ervoor dat ze zich meteen op hun gemak voelen.
  • Je legt duidelijk en vriendelijk uit hoe onze speelautomaten en spellen werken, zodat iedereen met vertrouwen kan deelnemen.
  • Bij winst zorg jij voor een vlotte, correcte en discrete uitbetaling.
  • Je biedt drankjes en kleine snacks aan om de spelervaring compleet te maken.

  • Je bouwt expertise op in klantvriendelijkheid en bent een sleutelpersoon in het creëren van een premium beleving.

title: Multi-skilled maintenance technician - English is allowed!
description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

  • Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
  • Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
  • Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
  • Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
  • Supervise external contractors and service providers

You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

  • Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
  • Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
  • Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
  • Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
  • Already living in Belgium, preferably in the greater area of Oostkamp

Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not required, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC...

title: Order picker - night shift - English allowed!
description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

  • Making orders based on order lists
  • Preparing completed orders for shipment
  • Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks

You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

  • Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
  • Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
  • Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
  • Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

title: Production worker
description:

Jobomschrijving

For our client, a family-run and growing company based in IZEGEM, we are looking for a production worker to strengthen the team. Do you enjoy working with fresh products, are you precise, and not afraid to work in a cooled environment? Then keep reading!

description:
Voor onze klant, een internationaal gerenommeerde keten van gezellige ontbijt- en lunchzaken waar kwaliteit, gastvrijheid en authentieke beleving centraal staan, zijn wij op zoek naar een enthousiaste Teamleader (M/V/X).

title: Call agent Donorcentrum Mechelen, 19u
description:
Rode Kruis-Vlaanderen is dé werkgever voor gemotiveerde kandidaten die alles uit hun job willen halen met het oog op een bloeiende carrière. Van jobs in verpleegkunde en labo's, sociale hulpverlening, IT- HR- en managementfuncties, help ons helpen en maak er je job van!

Elke dag hebben mensen bloed nodig: na een operatie, een bevalling, een verkeersongeval...
Daarom zamelt Rode Kruis-Vlaanderen jaarlijks ruim 350.000 bloedgiften in.

Heb jij een vlotte babbel en een warm hart voor anderen? Ben je op zoek naar een flexibele job waarin je echt een verschil kunt maken? Dan hebben wij de perfecte kans voor jou bij Rode Kruis-Vlaanderen als call agent in Donorcentrum Mechelen

Functiebeschrijving
    • Als call agent ben je dé stem van ons donorteam.
    • Je speelt een cruciale rol in het behoud van onze levensreddende bloed- en plasmavoorraad door donoren op te bellen en hen te motiveren om een nieuwe donatieafspraak te maken.
    • Je zorgt ervoor dat onze donoren zich gewaardeerd voelen en helpt hen bij de planning van hun volgende afspraak.
    • Je geeft donoren informatie omtrent hun donatie.
    • Je bent ambassadeur van Rode Kruis-Vlaanderen.

    Wat ga je doen?

    • Actief benaderen van onze trouwe en/of nieuwe donoren om nieuwe donatieafspraken in te plannen.
    • Beantwoorden van vragen van donoren en hen voorzien van de juiste informatie.
    • Bijhouden van afspraken en zorgen voor een nauwkeurige administratieve opvolging.
    • Donoren enthousiasmeren en bedanken voor hun waardevolle bijdrage.
  • Je bent communicatief sterk.
  • Je hebt uitstekende luistervaardigheden.
  • Je hebt het nodige geduld om op een zeer correcte manier telefoongesprekken uit te voeren.
  • Moeilijke telefoongesprekken schrikken jou niet af.
  • Je hebt een sterke overtuigingskracht.
  • Je bent sociaal ingesteld.
  • Je hebt een vriendelijke en duidelijke telefoonstem.
  • Je bent snel vertrouwd met nieuwe (bedrijfs)applicaties.
  • Je bent bereid om te werken volgens volgend schema, en mogelijks ook eventuele andere momenten volgens de noden van de bloedproducten:
    • Maandag, dinsdag en donderdag: van 16u tot 19u45
    • Woensdag: van 12u tot 15u
    • Vrijdag: van 12u tot 15u45
  • Ervaring met telefonisch klantencontact is een pluspunt.

title: Maintenance Technician
description:
Are you passionate about industrial technology and do you gain energy from solving technical challenges?

For our sites in Neder-over-Heembeek and Brucargo, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician who maintains and optimises industrial installations with dedication and expertise.

You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability of our technical systems. We invest in safety, training and your development, and we value your technical expertise. Together, we build a future based on innovation, reliability and teamwork.


Your responsibilities

  • Preventive maintenance: carry out preventive maintenance according to the maintenance plan and inspect machines to avoid breakdowns.
  • Corrective & improvement maintenance: analyse and resolve faults, replace or adjust parts, consult technical documentation and ensure optimal machine performance.
  • Optimisation: analyse recurring issues and propose improvement actions to increase performance and availability.
  • Use of CMMS: record interventions, write fault analyses, prepare reports and monitor stock levels.
  • Safety: ensure a clean and safe working environment and actively contribute to safety improvements.
  • Support & training: provide technical support to colleagues and operational teams.
  • Quality & environment: work in accordance with current procedures (ISO 9001 & ISO 14001).
  • Solid technical background (mechanics, electricity or electromechanics).
  • Autonomous, thorough and solution‑oriented.
  • Experience with industrial installations is an asset. Knowledge of CMMS systems is a plus.
  • Strong safety awareness, quality‑oriented and eager to learn.
  • Willing to work in a 3‑shift system (Mon–Fri).
  • Excellent command of English; knowledge of French / Dutch is an advantage

title: Huishoudhulp thuiszorg - regio Nazareth, De Pinte (deeltijds)
description:
Familiehulp ondersteunt mensen in hun dagelijks leven, met aandacht voor zorg, welzijn, huishouden en schoonmaak.

 

Als huishoudhulp / poetshulp in de thuiszorg ondersteun je mensen met een zorgbehoefte.

Je helpt hen voornamelijk met huishoudelijke taken zodat zij comfortabel thuis kunnen blijven wonen.

De klant is altijd thuis als jij er bent en je werkt samen met collega's huishoudhulpen en verzorgenden in een zorgteam.

Jouw taken zijn :

  • Het schoonmaken en poetsen van de woning.
  • Af en toe de was en strijk .
  • Een luisterend oor en aandacht voor het welzijn van je klant.
  • Het signaleren van noden of veranderingen aan je collega's wanneer dat nodig is.
  • Geen ervaring of diploma nodig.
  • Je hebt een hart voor mensen en haalt voldoening uit huishoudelijke hulp, poetsen en schoonmaken bij klanten thuis.
  • Je houdt van sociaal contact, maar werkt ook graag zelfstandig.
  • Je werkt stipt en overlegt vlot met je klant en het zorgteam.
  • Je bent betrouwbaar en hebt respect voor de privacy van je klanten.

  • Je beschikt over eigen vervoer.

In sommige regio's is ander aangepast vervoer handig om bij de klanten te geraken, zeker als je voltijds werkt.

title: Medewerker sociaal restaurant (V,M,X)
description:
Organisatie
De RuimteVaart is een plek van en voor mensen in armoede in Leuven. Samen met een diverse groep betrokken mensen werken we aan vernieuwende antwoorden op het armoedevraagstuk.

In ons sociaal restaurant kunnen mensen terecht voor een lekkere, betaalbare maaltijd.

Meer info over onze activiteiten en manier van werken vind je op www.deruimtevaart.be.

Functie
Je wordt ingeschakeld in het sociale restaurant. Hieronder volgen de hoofdtaken van je werk, zonder dat dit een volledige opsomming is.

Binnen het sociale restaurant sta je o.a. in voor:

- het kuisen en snijden van groenten en het bereiden van maaltijden en desserten,

- het bedienden van klanten,

- het afwassen, opruimen en opkuisen van het restaurant,

- deelname aan teamvergaderingen en –activiteiten.

Je werkt in een Vereniging waar mensen in armoede het woord nemen. Hier is er ook een gezinswerking en een team duurzaam wonen en we werken rond armoede en participatie. Soms helpen we elkaar uit de nood en spring je mee in waar nodig.

Deze functie staat specifiek en uitsluitend open voor personen met een advies individueel maatwerk vanuit VDAB/OCMW met middelmatige tot hoge begeleidingsnood.

Persoonlijke en professionele houding

Je werkt graag in een erg divers team.

Je bent gemotiveerd en zet je volledig in.

Je kan gevarieerd werk aan en houdt van afwisseling.

Gezonde voeding en armoede zijn dingen die je interesseren.

Je kan Nederlands spreken. Andere talen zijn een plus (Engels, Frans, Arabisch, …)

Competenties

1. Je bent sociaal en gaat respectvol, geduldig en discreet om met klanten, vrijwilligers en medewerkers. Je kan in team werken.

2. Je hebt een goede fysieke gezondheid , zodat je zeker 2 uur staand werk en wat opkuiswerk aan kan. Een gezonde rug/schouders zijn welkom voor laden & lossen en het wegzetten van voedsel.

3. Het is fijn als je kan koken. Minstens heb je zin om het te leren.

title: IT & Cyber Third Party Risk Assessor
description:

In this strategic role, you will safeguard our client's operations by assessing and managing IT and cyber risks related to external vendors and intragroup providers, with a strong focus on cloud services and key technology partners.

Working Model

  • 50% onsite in Brussels
  • 50% remote

If this aligns with your profile in information security and cyber risk, we would welcome a discussion about joining our client's team.

To find out more about Huxley please visit www.huxley.com
  • Third-Party IT & Security Assessments - Conduct due diligence, evaluate controls and ensure suppliers meet security and regulatory expectations.
  • Cloud Security (SaaS, IaaS, PaaS) - Assess cloud solutions and providers, reviewing architectures and risk mitigations.
  • Vulnerability Management & Penetration Testing - Analyse reports, challenge remediation plans and track closure of critical findings.

title: Policy Officer - Consumer & Market Affairs
description:
With a strong international presence, the organization collaborates with policymakers, industry leaders, regulatory bodies, and civil society stakeholders to address evolving economic and societal challenges. Its multidisciplinary approach combines analytical expertise, evidence-based policy development, and constructive dialogue to drive meaningful and lasting impact.


Jobomschrijving

As a Policy Officer your responsibilities are:

  • Monitor and analyse European and international policy, regulatory, and market developments relevant to consumers and businesses.
  • Conduct research and provide evidence-based analysis on economic, regulatory, and market-related topics.
  • Translate complex policy, economic, and regulatory information into clear recommendations and strategic insights.
  • Support the development and implementation of advocacy, public affairs, and policy initiatives.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with policymakers, industry representatives, regulatory bodies, and other key stakeholders.
  • Represent the organization in meetings, conferences, working groups, and external events.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to maximize the impact of policy and advocacy activities.
  • Prepare policy papers, briefing notes, position statements, and stakeholder communications.
  • Support the planning and execution of stakeholder engagement activities and events.
  • Identify emerging trends, challenges, and opportunities, and contribute innovative ideas to strengthen the organization's influence and impact.

A successful Policy Officer should have:

  • Master's degree in Economics, Business, Public Policy, Political Science, or a related discipline.
  • Relevant experience in public affairs, policy, advocacy, consultancy, regulatory affairs, or a comparable environment.
  • Strong understanding of economic and market trends and their impact on consumers and businesses.
  • Good knowledge of the European policy and regulatory landscape.
  • Excellent analytical, research, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics for different audiences.
  • Proven ability to build relationships and engage effectively with senior stakeholders.
  • Confident, proactive, and capable of representing an organization externally.
  • Collaborative team player with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Fluent in English; additional European languages are considered an asset.

title: German-Speaking Customer Support Advisor | Telecommunications (m,w,d) anywhere in Bulgaria (Callcenteragent/in)
description:
Start : 14/9

Training online. One week to spend in Varna  after the training for the nesting phase. Afterwards anywhere in Bulgaria!

We are partnering with a leading international customer experience provider to recruit German-speaking Customer Support Advisors for a telecommunications project in Bulgaria.

This is a remote position within Bulgaria, combining customer service, technical troubleshooting, and light sales. You’ll support German-speaking customers with their mobile services, billing questions, and technical issues while identifying opportunities to recommend suitable additional products.

Important: While the role is remote, candidates must be available to complete 1 week of on-site nesting in Varna after the initial remote training period. The role operates Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week, with rotating shifts between 09:00 and 19:00.

Your Role

- Support German-speaking customers via phone and email
- Resolve technical, billing, and general service enquiries
- Handle complaints professionally and ensure timely resolution

- Accurately document customer interactions and relevant information

Your Qualifications

- German C1
- English B1 or above
- High school diploma or equivalent
- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
- Customer-focused and comfortable handling complaints
- Interest in troubleshooting and technical support
- Previous customer service or contact centre experience is an advantage, but not required
- Based in Bulgaria or willing to relocate

The Offer

- Remote working model within Bulgaria, with only 1 week of mandatory on-site nesting in Varna
- Indefinite employment contract
- Competitive salary plus performance bonus
- Uncapped sales bonus, averaging approximately €200/month
- Relocation package for eligible EU citizens, including transportation reimbursement and a €260/month accommodation allowance for the first 3 months
- Meal allowance
- Private health insurance
- Multisport and/or Coolfit card
- Access to an online learning platform
- Monday to Friday schedule – weekends off
- Comprehensive training and long-term career development opportunities

description:
MEHANIČAR/MEHANIČARKA-MEHATRONIČAR/MEHATRONIČARKA

Kao obiteljsko poduzeće znamo da su ljudi ti, koji svojim znanjem i vještinama pridonose našem uspjehu. Isto im vraćamo sa stimulativnim primanjima i korporativnom kulturom u kojoj se žive obiteljske vrijednosti. Želimo biti više od skupine timova u jednom poduzeću. Međusobna suradnja znači za nas međusobnu povezanost. Svi smo složni u uvjerenju da zajedno postižemo velike stvari.

Kao poduzeće. Kao tim. Kao obitelj.

Očekuju te sljedeći zadaci:

  • Redovito održavanje strojeva u proizvodnom pogonu
  • Utvrđivanje i otklanjanje kvarova na strojevima
  • Izvođenje servisa, remonta i montaže strojeva
  • Briga o zalihi rezervnih dijelova
  • Godišnje provođenje ispitivanja elektro uređaja

Što donosiš sa sobom:

  • Završena škola: elektrotehničar, elektromehaničar, mehatroničar ili električar, stručnjak za pneumatiku i hidrauliku
  • Poželjno radno iskustvo minimalno 2 godine u području održavanja pneumatskih i hidrauličnih strojeva
  • Pouzdanost i samostalnost u obavljanju radnih zadataka
  • Izraženi timski duh
  • Fleksibilnost
  • Poželjno poznavanje engleskog ili njemačkog jezika u govoru i pismu

Što te očekuje:

  • Rad u internacionalnom okruženju
  • Stimulativna primanja
  • Mogućnost napredovanja
  • Ugovor na neodređeno vrijeme
  • Poticajna i prijateljska radna atmosfera
  • Uvođenje u posao pod vodstvom mentora
  • Dvosmjenski rad
  • Vrhunska oprema i postrojenje
  • Veliki benefit paket (npr. team building, božićni domjenak, sportske aktivnosti, osiguranje 0-24, uplata u 3. mirovinski stup i još mnoge pogodnosti)

title: TEHNIČAR/KA ZA PRIPREMU SMJENE
description:
HRVATSKI DUHANI d.d. dio su grupe British American Tobacco, jedna od vodećih svjetskih multinacionalnih kompanija u području duhanske industrije. Zahvaljujući našim zaposlenicima nastavili smo rasti, stoga tražimo motiviranu i odgovornu osobu za rad na poziciji: Tehničar/ka za pripremu smjene Glavne odgovornosti i zadaci:
  • Zaduženje za održavanje strojeva linije obrade duhana i otklanjanje pronađenih nedostataka najranije moguće.
  • Dnevno kontrolira čišćenje, podmazivanje, kontrole curenja ulja na svim strojevima.
  • Svakodnevno provjeravanje podešenosti strojeva te izvršenje potrebnih podešavanja.
  • Dnevna kontrola i otklanjanje kvarova na sustavu linija otprašivanja.
  • Popravak i remont linija obrade duhana, linija sjetve i otkupa duhana te popravci i zamjena mehaničkih komponenata i sklopova na opremi iz svog djelokruga.
  • Redovno provjerava radno stanje opreme, radi tehnička podešavanja, obavještava Rukovoditelja održavanja o uočenim problemima.
  • Radi na smanjenju potrošnje energije.
  • Izrada dijelova u skladu sa dostavljenim specifikacijama.
  • Rastavljanje strojeva u slučaju potrebe, popravak i zamjena neispravnih komponenti strojeva.
  • Sudjeluje u instalaciji proizvodne opreme i strojeva.
  • Nadzire rad opreme i strojeva, brine o hidraulučnim platformama i pometačima podova u pogonu.
  • Održava čistoću i urednost radnog okruženja.
  • Sudjeluje u pripremi akcija preventivnog održavanja.
  • Osigurava da su svi alati i materijali koji se koriste prikladni, sigurni i u skladu s relevantnim standardima i zahtjevima tvrtke.
  • Održavanje, popravci i zamjena mehaničkih komponenata i sklopova na opremi iz svogdjelokruga.
  • Po potrebi radi u drugim sektorima, sva područja obrade duhana (pakiranje, sušenje, biranje, ulaz, itd.), na sjetvi plitica, otkupu duhana.
  • Ostali zadaci u skladu s naravi i vrstom rada po nalogu neposredno nadređenog.
Uvjeti
  • Potrebna stručna sprema: SSS-srednja stručna sprema.
  • Zahtijevana struka: tehnička struke (elektro, strojarska).
  • Osnovno znanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu.
  • Osnovno znanje rada na računalu: Ms Office.
  • Vozačka dozvola B kategorije.
Prednosti
  • Sposobnost brze identifikacije i rješavanja problema.
  • Iskustvo u razumijevanju tehničke dokumentacije.
  • Izvrsna sposobnost vođenja evidencije.
  • Komunikacijske vještine.
  • Fleksibilnost i timski rad.
  • Sposobnost postavljanja prioriteta.
  • Poželjno radno iskustvo od dvije godine u struci ili na sličnim poslovima.
Nudimo benefite i pogodnosti:
  • Briga o zdravlju: dopunsko i dodatno zdravstveno osiguranje (sistematski i specijalistički pregledi i slično), osiguranje zaposlenika od nezgode (24/7), besplatno korištenje teretane.
  • Financijske pogodnosti: Božićnica, regres za godišnji odmor, naknada za podmirivanje troškova prehrane, potpora za rođenje djeteta, naknada za troškove prijevoza, itd.
  • Priznanja i nagrade: godišnji bonus, godišnja korekcija plaće, razna nefinacijska nagrađivanja putem nominacija za prepoznavanje truda i postignuća.
  • Balans privatnog i poslovnog: plaćeni i neplaćeni dopust za razne osobne potrebe, slobodan radni dan povodom rođendana zaposlenika, razna online savjetovanja za zaposlenike i programi pomoći te savjetovanja za razne životne teme.
  • Okruženje koje pokreće: podršku od strane kolega i voditelja, kontinuirani razvoj kroz stručno usavršavanje, obilježavanje događaja gdje slavimo uspjeh i izražavamo zahvalnost prema našim zaposlenicima.
Trajanje ugovora: Na određeno vrijeme s mogućnošću zasnivanja radnog odnosa na neodređeno vrijeme. Raspon bruto I plaće: 1.080,00 – 1.350,00 € Životopis i molbu dostaviti na e-mail adresu: posao_hd@bat.com uz obaveznu naznaku u naslovu mail-a za koji točno natječaj se prijavljujete. Prijavite se na oglas i pridružite se uspješnoj međunarodnoj grupi. Veselimo se Vašoj prijavi!

title: VODITELJ/VODITELJICA PROJEKTA U SERVISU
description:
Opis posla:
  • vođenje i koordinacija projekata servisiranja, održavanja, popravaka i remonta jahti i brodica
  • pregled potrebnih radova, mjerenje te detaljna razrada potrebnog materijala i opreme
  • priprema specifikacija i narudžbi materijala za potrebe servisnih projekata
  • komunikacija s dobavljačima te praćenje nabave i rokova isporuke materijala
  • svakodnevna komunikacija s klijentima, serviserima, kooperantima i dobavljačima
  • komunikacija s domaćim i međunarodnim klijentima i poslovnim partnerima na hrvatskom i engleskom jeziku
  • organizacija i koordinacija rada servisera i vanjskih kooperanata
  • izrada narudžbi, radnih naloga i ostale dokumentacije vezane uz administrativni i operativni dio Servisa Marine Nautica Novigrad
  • praćenje tijeka projekta, izvršenih radova, utrošenog materijala, radnih sati i usluga kooperanata
  • kontrola kvalitete i dinamike izvođenja ugovorenih radova
  • pravovremeno prepoznavanje dodatnih radova i komunikacija s klijentom vezano uz njihovu realizaciju
  • koordinacija potrebnih aktivnosti kako bi se osiguralo nesmetano i pravovremeno odvijanje projekata
  • provedba radova i procesa potrebnih za realizaciju projekata remonta i popravaka plovila, uz primjenu odgovarajućih znanja i razumijevanja tehnoloških procesa
  • priprema potrebnih podataka i dokumentacije za završni obračun projekta
  • vođenje projekata u skladu s dogovorenim rokovima, opsegom radova i definiranim troškovima
  • izvođenje drugih poslova prema uputama poslodavca

OD KANDIDATA OČEKUJEMO

  • tehničko znanje i interes za nautiku, brodogradnju i servisiranje plovila
  • sposobnost samostalne organizacije i vođenja servisnih projekata
  • izražene organizacijske i komunikacijske sposobnosti
  • odgovornost, preciznost i sistematičnost u radu
  • sposobnost istovremenog praćenja više projekata i prioriteta
  • dobro poznavanje rada na računalu i MS Office paketa
  • dobro znanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu
  • vozačku dozvolu B kategorije
  • spremnost na timski rad i svakodnevnu komunikaciju s klijentima, dobavljačima i kooperantima

Prednost imaju kandidati s prethodnim iskustvom u nautici, brodogradnji, servisiranju plovila, tehničkom održavanju ili vođenju projekata, kao i kandidati koji poznaju brodske sustave, materijale i tehnološke procese vezane uz održavanje i remont plovila.

title: UČITELJ/ICA ENGLESKOG JEZIKA
description: Objava natječaja na HZZZ-u od 28.09.- 06.10.2026. Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (Narodne novine br. 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10. - ispr., 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18 i 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 156/23), članka 13. Pravilnika o radu i članaka 6. i 7. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja Osnovne škole Remete (u daljnjem tekstu: Pravilnik), ravnatelj Osnovne škole Remete objavljuje: N A T J E Č A J za zasnivanje radnog odnosa 1. Učitelj/ica engleskog jezika, na određeno, nepuno radno vrijeme (6 sati tjedno), 1 izvršitelj/ica Uvjeti: Kandidati uz opće uvjete za zasnivanje radnog odnosa, sukladno općim propisima o radu, moraju ispunjavati i posebne uvjete propisane Zakonom o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (Narodne novine br.: 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 156/23) i čl.17. Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (Narodne novine br. 6/19, 75/20). Na natječaj se mogu javiti muške i ženske osobe u skladu sa Zakonom o ravnopravnosti spolova (Narodne novine br. 82/08 i 69/17) U prijavi na natječaj navode se i podaci podnositelja prijave (ime i prezime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona odnosno mobitela, adresa e-pošte, isključivo za potrebe postupka), naziv radnog mjesta za koje se prijavljuje i datum objave natječaja. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj, kandidati su dužni priložiti: 1. životopis 2. dokaz o državljanstvu 3. diplomu, odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi 4. uvjerenje nadležnog suda da kandidat nije pod istragom i da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak za neko od kaznenih djela iz čl.106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana raspisivanja natječaja 5. elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje Navedene isprave odnosno prilozi dostavljaju se u neovjerenoj preslici i ne vraćaju se kandidatu nakon završenog natječajnog postupka. Prije sklapanja ugovora o radu odabrani kandidat dužan je sve navedene priloge odnosno isprave predočiti u izvorniku ili u preslici ovjerenoj od strane javnog bilježnika. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19 i 84/21), članku 48. stavku 1.-3. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 i 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20) dužna je u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja i ovisno o kategoriji u koju ulazi sve potrebne dokaze (članak 103.st.1.Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja te priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju (čl.49.st.1. Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Prijavom na natječaj svaki kandidat daje privolu Osnovnoj školi Remete za obradu osobnih podataka u skladu s propisima kojima je propisana zaštita osobnih podataka za svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka i objave rezultata natječaja. Rok za podnošenje prijava kandidata je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj i o tome se ne radi posebna obavijest. Kandidat/kinja koji/a je pravodobno dostavio/la potpunu prijavu sa svim ispravama odnosno prilozima i ispunjava uvjete natječaja dužan/a je pristupiti procjeni odnosno testiranju prema odredbama Pravilnika. Odluku o vremenu, mjestu i načinu održavanja procjene vrednovanja kandidata/kinje Škola će objaviti na mrežnoj stranici Osnovne škole Remete http://www.os-remete-zg.skole.hr s napomenom da se kandidati/kinje neće posebno pozivati. Obavijest o ishodu natječajnog postupka, objavit će se na mrežnoj stranici Osnovne škole Remete http://www.os-remete-zg.skole.hr najkasnije u roku od osam dana od dana sklapanja ugovora s odabranim kandidatom. U slučaju da se na natječaj prijave kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom propisu, kandidati će se obavijestiti prema članku 17. stavku 4. Pravilnika. Prijave na natječaj s potrebnom dokumentacijom kandidati dostavljaju neposredno ili poštom na adresu: Osnovna škola Remete, Remete 99a, 10 000 Zagreb, s naznakom “za natječaj- Učitelj/ica engleskog jezika“.

Na natječaj se mogu javiti muške i ženske osobe u skladu sa Zakonom o ravnopravnosti spolova (Narodne novine br. 82/08 i 69/17) U prijavi na natječaj navode se i podaci podnositelja prijave (ime i prezime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona odnosno mobitela, adresa e-pošte, isključivo za potrebe postupka), naziv radnog mjesta za koje se prijavljuje i datum objave natječaja. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj, kandidati su dužni priložiti: 1. životopis 2. dokaz o državljanstvu 3. diplomu, odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi 4. uvjerenje nadležnog suda da kandidat nije pod istragom i da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak za neko od kaznenih djela iz čl.106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana raspisivanja natječaja 5. elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje Navedene isprave odnosno prilozi dostavljaju se u neovjerenoj preslici i ne vraćaju se kandidatu nakon završenog natječajnog postupka. Prije sklapanja ugovora o radu odabrani kandidat dužan je sve navedene priloge odnosno isprave predočiti u izvorniku ili u preslici ovjerenoj od strane javnog bilježnika. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19 i 84/21), članku 48. stavku 1.-3. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 i 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20) dužna je u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja i ovisno o kategoriji u koju ulazi sve potrebne dokaze (članak 103.st.1.Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja te priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju (čl.49.st.1. Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Prijavom na natječaj svaki kandidat daje privolu Osnovnoj školi Remete za obradu osobnih podataka u skladu s propisima kojima je propisana zaštita osobnih podataka za svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka i objave rezultata natječaja. Rok za podnošenje prijava kandidata je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj i o tome se ne radi posebna obavijest. Kandidat/kinja koji/a je pravodobno dostavio/la potpunu prijavu sa svim ispravama odnosno prilozima i ispunjava uvjete natječaja dužan/a je pristupiti procjeni odnosno testiranju prema odredbama Pravilnika. Odluku o vremenu, mjestu i načinu održavanja procjene vrednovanja kandidata/kinje Škola će objaviti na mrežnoj stranici Osnovne škole Remete http://www.os-remete-zg.skole.hr s napomenom da se kandidati/kinje neće posebno pozivati. Obavijest o ishodu natječajnog postupka, objavit će se na mrežnoj stranici Osnovne škole Remete http://www.os-remete-zg.skole.hr najkasnije u roku od osam dana od dana sklapanja ugovora s odabranim kandidatom. U slučaju da se na natječaj prijave kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom propisu, kandidati će se obavijestiti prema članku 17. stavku 4. Pravilnika. Prijave na natječaj s potrebnom dokumentacijom kandidati dostavljaju neposredno ili poštom na adresu: Osnovna škola Remete, Remete 99a, 10 000 Zagreb, s naznakom “za natječaj- Učitelj/ica matematike i fizike“.

title: TERENSKI SERVISER/KA
description:
Terenski serviser (m/ž)

Ključni zadaci i odgovornosti:

  • izvođenje servisnih radova u tvrtki i na terenu, na uređajima tvrtke RASCO i na ostalim uređajima koje tvrtka RASCO zastupa i distribuira
  • remont strojeva preuzetih od kupaca
  • izvođenje osnovne obuke za upravljanje Rasco strojevima i uređajima, i onima koje tvrtka RASCO zastupa
  • prijava nesukladnosti prikupljenih sa terena
  • unos podataka i korekcija u baze podataka kojima raspolaže servis
  • vođenje točnih zapisa vezanih za servisne radne naloge
  • kontrola tehničke ispravnosti i održavanje osobnih, dostavnih i teretnih vozila tvrtke

Traženi profil kandidata:

  • SSS tehničkog usmjerenja (automehaničar, autoelektričar, elektromonter itd.)
  • Poželjno 1 - 3 godina radnog iskustvu u sličnim poslovima, ali razmotriti ćemo i kandidate bez radnog iskustva, a koji su spremni proći intenzivnu obuku namijenjenu serviserima početnicima
  • Engleski ili njemački jezik (osnovna razina)
  • Korištenje računalom i MS Office aplikacijama (osnovno)
  • Vozačka dozvola B kategorija
  • Sklonost terenskom radu
  • Odgovoran pristup radnim zadacima
  • Sklonost timskom radu i fleksibilnost u poslu

Što nudimo:

  • Početnu plaću sukladno prethodnom iskustvu uz jasno definiranu mogućnost povećanja primanja nakon savladavanja zahtjeva radnog mjesta
  • Naknade troškova prijevoza na posao i s posla, dodatak za topli obrok i radne rezultate kao i isplata pripadajućih dnevnica i terenskog dodatka i prekovremenog rada na terenu
  • Ugovor o radu na neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rad od 3 mjeseca
  • Mentora i sustavno praćenje napretka s ciljem osiguravanja podrške i uspješno uvođenje u posao
  • Dodatne edukacije vezane uz specifičnosti radnog mjesta i edukacije namijenjene osobnom razvoju
  • Radno okružje s visokom razinom odgovornosti te rad sa iskusnim stručnjacima u navedenom području

Mjesto rada: Kalinovac, Koprivničko-križevačka županija Molimo pošaljite nam svoju prijavu i životopis najkasnije do 31.10.2026. godine.

title: STROJAR U SLUŽBI PROČIŠĆAVANJA OTPADNIH VODA
description:
Na temelju članka 28. stavka 1. Zakona o vodnim uslugama (NN 66/19) i članka 35. Društvenog ugovora Vodovoda d.o.o. Zadar, te sukladno Smjernicama za provedbu Odluke o donošenju općih akata o postupku zapošljavanja u trgovačkim društvima u vlasništvu Grada Zadra i ustanovama kojima je osnivač, direktor Društva Tomislav Matek, dipl. ing. građ., objavljuje

JAVNI NATJEČAJ

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa za radno mjesto:

Strojar u Službi pročišćavanja otpadnih voda

(broj izvršitelja 1)

Radni odnos zasniva se na neodređeno vrijeme, uz probni rad u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci.

Uvjeti:

Minimalna razina obrazovanja: SSS strojarskog smjera

Mjesto rada: Zadar

Radno vrijeme:puno radno vrijeme

Raspored radnog vremena: 1 smjena - prijepodne

Naknada za prijevoz: u cijelosti

Smještaj: nema

Radno iskustvo: 3 godine radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima

Vozačka dozvola: B kategorija

Plaća: 1.335,14 € do 1.535,40 € bruto

Opis posla:

  • kontroliranje, popravljanje, ugradnja i održavanje strojarske opreme, uređaja i crpki u
  • procesu pročišćavanja otpadnih voda i crpnim stanicama,
  • rukovanje zasunima i zapornicama ručno ili daljinskim upravljanjem, pokretanje i
  • zaustavljanje rada crpki i opreme koja se koristi u tehnološkom postupka pročišćavanja
  • otpadnih voda,
  • obavljanje rutinskih poslova na održavanju opreme, remont opreme, servisi opreme,
  • zamjena ulja, podmazivanje zapornica i opreme koja se koristi u pročišćavanju otpadnih
  • voda ,
  • održavanje strojarske opreme i crpki (kontrola nastanka korozije, zaštita adekvatnim
  • premazima),
  • rukovanje i upravljanje strojo opremom, podmazivanje i kontrola nivoa ulja,
  • praćenje intervala za redovite servise opreme,
  • briga oko pravovremene nabavke rezervnih dijelova,
  • održavanje opreme u službi pročišćavanja otpadnih voda (pranje, čišćenje),
  • rukovanje s opasnim kemikalijama,
  • nadopuna kemikalija u odgovarajuće spremnike prema radnim postupcima,,

U prijavi je potrebno navesti osobne podatke: ime i prezime, adresu stanovanja, broj telefona/mobitela i e-mail adresu te priložiti slijedeću dokumentaciju:

  1. Životopis;
  2. Dokaz o ispunjavanju uvjeta stručne spreme (preslik svjedodžbe/diplome);
  3. Dokaz o posjedovanju vozačke dozvole B kategorije
  4. Elektronički zapis o radno pravnom statusu (e radna knjižica);

Sva tražena dokumentacija može se dostaviti u neovjerenoj preslici a dostavljena dokumentacija se ne vraća. Kandidat koji bude odabran, dužan je dostaviti na uvid dokumentaciju u izvorniku.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji ("Narodne novine" br.121/17, 198/19, 84/21 i 156/23) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je priložiti, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja, i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom ("Narodne novine" br.157/13, 152/14,39/18 I 32/20), dužan se pozvati na čl. 9. istog Zakona te uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja priložiti dokaze o priznatom statusu osobe s invaliditetom sukladno Pravilniku o sadržaju i načinu vođenja očevidnika zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno odredbi članka 48.f Zakona о zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata ("Narodne novine” 33/92, 77/92, 27/93,58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 I 98/19) dužan je priložiti, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, rješenje odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, te dokaz o tome na koji mu je način prestao radni odnos.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno odredbi članka 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima Domovinskog rata ("Narodne novine" 84/21) dužan se pozvati na pravo prednosti te uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja, priložiti dokaze iz članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima Domovinskog rata. dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/84.

Između više kandidata koji ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja, Poslodavac zadržava pravo izbora u uži krug kandidata koji će biti pozvani na razgovor. Poslodavac zadržava pravo obaviti i testiranje kandidata.

Prijavom na natječaj kandidati pristaju na obradu svojih osobnih podataka, u svrhu provođenja odabira kandidata. Sa dostavljenom dokumentacijom raspolažemo u skladu s Izjavom o zaštiti osobnih podataka objavljenoj na web stranici Društva https://www.vodovod-zadar.hr /

Prijave za natječaj podnose se putem preporučene pošte na adresu: 23 000 Zadar, Špire Brusine 17 ili osobno na adresu sjedišta društva Vodovod d.o.o., Špire Brusine 17, 23 000 Zadar (pisarnica) ili se podnose u elektroničkom obliku na e-mail adresu vodovod1@vodovod-zadar.hr a sve s naznakom „Natječaj za radno mjesto: Strojar u Službi pročišćavanja otpadnih voda „

Ovaj Natječaj objavljuje se na stranicama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje i web stranice Društva https://www.vodovod-zadar.hr/ i Grada Zadra.

Rok za predaju prijava je 11.10.2026. godine.

Prijave koje ne ispunjavaju uvjete iz natječaja, koje su pristigle van roka za predaju ili koje su nepotpune neće se uzeti u razmatranje.

Kandidati će biti obaviješteni o ishodu javnog natječaja.

Vodovod d.o.o. Zadar pridržava pravo poništiti javni natječaj u cijelosti ili djelomično, bez navođenja razloga.
