Field Service Technician (Region Central Switzerland) f/m/d (80\-100%)
======================================================================

At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.



**This position reports to:**

Service Team Leader



\_\_

In this position, you will perform service activities in accordance with work instructions and ABB quality and safety guidelines. You will ensure excellent customer service on a daily basis by planning service assignments and executing them in line with customer requirements and expectations. Through your clear and professional communication, you will contribute to customer satisfaction and loyalty by providing transparent information regarding schedules, processes, and expectations.



**Work model:** Field\-based



This role is part of the **Electrification, Smart Power** division in Baden. Your key stakeholders will include customers, field service colleagues, and the internal service coordination team.



You will be mainly accountable for:

* Collaborate with customers on\-site to identify optimization opportunities and resolve existing challenges
* Perform service assignments, identify technical issues, and conduct on\-site or remote analysis within the service categories and product areas for which you are certified
* Prepare material lists for service assignments and ensure that all required materials, spare parts, and tools are available, complete, and in proper working condition
* Provide training to field service colleagues and customers as required




**Our team**



You will become part of a collaborative and supportive team where you can continue to grow both professionally and personally.



**Your qualifications**



* Completed vocational training as an Automation Technician, Electrician, Electrical Installer, Electrical Planner, or a comparable technical qualification
* At least 3 years of professional experience in automation, electrical engineering, or a related technical field; experience with UPS systems (uninterruptible power supply) is an advantage
* Solid knowledge of electromechanical systems, diagnostic tools, and service processes in an industrial environment
* Strong customer focus, flexibility in adapting to changing requirements, and a solution\-oriented and collaborative approach to teamwork
* Fluent and basic English skills for professional communication with customers
* Willingness to travel, participate in an on\-call rotation, and occasionally work weekends; primary service area: Region Central Switzerland
* Valid driver's license for assignments within Switzerland




**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**



In dieser Position führen Sie Servicearbeiten gemäss den Arbeitsanweisungen sowie den Qualitäts\- und Sicherheitsrichtlinien von ABB durch. Sie stellen täglich einen ausgezeichneten Kundenservice sicher, indem Sie Serviceeinsätze planen und diese entsprechend den Anforderungen und Erwartungen der Kunden ausführen. Durch Ihre klare und professionelle Kommunikation tragen Sie zur Kundenzufriedenheit und Kundenbindung bei, indem Sie transparente Informationen zu Zeitplänen, Abläufen und Erwartungen vermitteln.


**Arbeitsmodell:** Aussendienst


Diese Position ist Teil der Division **Electrification, Smart Power** in Baden. Zu Ihren wichtigsten Ansprechpartnern gehören Kunden, Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Field Service sowie das interne Service\-Koordinationsteam.


Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

* Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden vor Ort, um Optimierungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und bestehende Herausforderungen zu lösen
* Durchführung von Serviceeinsätzen, Identifizierung technischer Probleme sowie Durchführung von Analysen vor Ort oder aus der Ferne innerhalb der Servicekategorien und Produktbereiche, für die Sie zertifiziert sind
* Erstellung von Materiallisten für Serviceeinsätze und Sicherstellung, dass alle erforderlichen Materialien, Ersatzteile und Werkzeuge vollständig verfügbar und in einwandfreiem Zustand sind
* Durchführung von Schulungen für Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Field Service sowie für Kunden nach Bedarf



**Unser Team**  
Sie werden Teil eines kollegialen und unterstützenden Teams, in dem Sie sich sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich weiterentwickeln können.  

**Ihre Qualifikationen**  


* Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Automatiker/in, Elektriker/in, Elektroinstallateur/in, Elektroplaner/in oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation
* Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Automatisierung, Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich; Erfahrung mit USV\-Anlagen (unterbrechungsfreie Stromversorgung) ist von Vorteil
* Fundierte Kenntnisse in elektromechanischen Systemen, Diagnosetools und Serviceprozessen im industriellen Umfeld
* Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung, Flexibilität bei wechselnden Anforderungen sowie eine lösungsorientierte und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise
* Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse und grundlegende Englischkenntnisse für die professionelle Kommunikation mit Kunden
* Reisebereitschaft, Bereitschaft zur Teilnahme am Pikettdienst sowie zu gelegentlichen Wochenendeinsätzen; primäres Servicegebiet: Region Zentralschweiz
* Gültiger Führerausweis für Einsätze innerhalb der Schweiz




\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_



**Benefits**



We offer our employees a range of attractive benefits, including:

* Attractive compensation package including bonus, 13th\-month salary, and Employee Share Acquisition Program (ESAP)
* Training, development, and career growth opportunities
* Company vehicle and attractive fleet discounts
* Contributions toward gym memberships and medical services (IFA)
* REKA vouchers and discounts through Swibeco




**More about us**



ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing facilities, critical infrastructure, and commercial buildings. The division's technical teams work closely with industry partners to develop innovative solutions that support growth, the energy transition, and sustainability goals.

Its portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low\-voltage systems, motor starting solutions, and safety devices such as switches and relays. The Power Protection business supports the world's largest data center companies with advanced and energy\-efficient UPS solutions. In addition, ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable and user\-friendly platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO₂ emissions.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

title: Technical Coordinator
description:
Established in 1927, SICPA is a Swiss private technology company that supports the effective governance and long\-term prosperity of nations. SICPA sets *the pulse of sovereignty*, enabling governments and institutions to authenticate and secure their vital assets. Our platform for sovereignty delivers custom solutions built on a century of cutting\-edge innovations in material, digital, and data science domains. At the center of every SICPA solution is a custom crafted molecule, unique to each nation.

For the development of our core strategic solutions, we are currently looking for a very experienced, top motivated, hands\-on:

**TECHNICAL COORDINATOR**

The Technical Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and driving the validation of industrial software for our coding machines. The role combines strong technical expertise, delivery accountability, and cross\-functional coordination, ensuring predictable execution, high quality, and continuous improvement of both processes and solutions.

**Role :**

* Drive coordination Software release validation for our industrial inhouse coding machines
* Plan, coordinate, and monitor validation and release activities for customer\-specific customizations.
* Actively manage planning, risks, technical dependencies, and delivery constraints, taking corrective actions through replanning, reprioritization, or mitigation when required.
* Investigate and solve technical dependencies with people in development teams, QA, deployment teams and operations. Assure availability of machines and material for validation.
* Plan and execute validation assuring operational readiness of coding machines at expected quality on the committed deadlines. Incorporate risks, constraints and dependencies into planning to be able to commit to a delivery date.
* Maintain a structured and transparent status of all ongoing validation activities
* Manage and follow up on incidents, problems, and change requests raised from operations or field technicians.
* Improve internal validation process and tooling for software release validation
* Promote and apply a continuous improvement mindset, simplifying processes, validation approaches, and technical solutions to improve efficiency, robustness, and time\-to\-market.
* Contribute to the software development of solution in Java
* Support activities both in the office and in the laboratory, including validation, commissioning, and operational support when required.


**Profile :**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a technical field (Software Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent).
* Minimum 2 years of experience in technical environments involving complex systems.
* Hands\-on expertise in software development (industrial software, platforms, backend or custom applications)
* Good technical understanding of software engineering domain, enabling effective coordination across multidisciplinary teams.
* Proven experience in delivery\-driven environments, managing timelines, priorities, dependencies, and risks.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills are key, with the ability to align stakeholders, facilitate collaboration, handle priorities, and address issues constructively.
* Ability to take a step back and maintain a global overview while remaining pragmatic and solution oriented.
* Comfortable working both in the office and on\-site (support, validation, commissioning, troubleshooting).
* Proactive, reliable, and results\-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Curious and improvement\-driven, continuously seeking to simplify processes and solutions.
* Fluent in English; Proficient in French; additional European languages are an asset.


**JOIN US!**

We offer an exciting and challenging role, with great potential for personal development within a unique organization in a fascinating industry. Your file will be handled with upmost confidentiality and discretion.

Agent·e de maintenance / Agent·e d’exploitation CFC
=======================================================







L’Association Les Châtaigniers exploite un établissement médico\-social (EMS), une organisation d’aide et de soins à domicile (OSAD) ainsi qu’une organisation d’ergothérapie. Elle considère que la qualité des prestations repose avant tout sur les femmes et les hommes qui les rendent possibles.



Elle développe une organisation fondée sur la compétence, la responsabilité, la confiance, la transparence et l’amélioration continue. L’Association inscrit l’ensemble de ses activités dans une démarche de management intégré visant à garantir la qualité des prestations, la sécurité des personnes accompagnées, la santé et la sécurité de ses collaborateurs, la protection de l’environnement et l’amélioration continue de ses pratiques.







Agent·e de maintenance / Agent·e d’exploitation CFC
=======================================================



**La fonction**



L’agent·e de maintenance assure l’entretien courant, les réparations et la maintenance des bâtiments, des installations techniques et des équipements de l’EMS. Il·elle veille à leur bon fonctionnement ainsi qu’à la sécurité des infrastructures, effectue les contrôles nécessaires et signale les éventuels dysfonctionnements.



Il·elle intervient en appui des différents services pour répondre à leurs besoins techniques. La fonction peut impliquer des horaires de travail irréguliers ainsi que des services de piquet la nuit et le week\-end.



Vos missions comprennent notamment :



* l’organisation et la planification de la maintenance ;  
* la maintenance préventive et corrective des bâtiments et des installations ;  
* l’entretien courant des bâtiments ;  
* l’assistance technique aux résidants et à leurs proches ;  
* la surveillance des installations et la réalisation des contrôles périodiques ;  
* le diagnostic des pannes et la réalisation des réparations nécessaires ;  
* le suivi de la maintenance des équipements médico\-techniques ;  
* la coordination des prestataires techniques et informatiques externes ;  
* la gestion du matériel, des pièces détachées et de la documentation technique ;  
* la participation aux mesures de sécurité et l’information des collaborateurs ;  
* l’assistance informatique de premier niveau ainsi que le suivi du matériel informatique, téléphonique et audiovisuel ;  
* l’appui logistique aux différents services.  


**Profil recherché**



Vous répondez notamment aux conditions suivantes :



* CFC dans un métier technique pertinent ou titre jugé équivalent ;  
* expérience professionnelle confirmée dans la maintenance de bâtiments et d’installations techniques ; une expérience en EMS ou dans le domaine sanitaire constitue un atout ;  
* qualification reconnue pour effectuer des travaux sur les installations propres à l’entreprise conformément à l’art. 13 OIBT, un atout ;  
* bonnes connaissances des installations techniques du bâtiment et aptitude à diagnostiquer les dysfonctionnements ;  
* connaissance des normes de sécurité et des principes de prévention des risques ;  
* bonnes compétences informatiques permettant d’assurer une assistance de premier niveau et le suivi du matériel ;  
* adhésion aux valeurs et au projet institutionnel de l’Association Les Châtaigniers ;  
* personnalité professionnelle polyvalente, autonome et organisée, faisant preuve de discernement, de sens des responsabilités et d’un bon esprit de collaboration ;  
* intérêt marqué pour le domaine de la personne âgée et aptitude à intervenir avec discrétion dans un lieu de vie ;  
* disponibilité pour assurer, selon les besoins, des horaires irréguliers et des services de piquet ;  
* bonne maîtrise du français, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

Recruteur(se) à 50 %
=====================

***Le Groupe Eldora est actif dans le domaine de la restauration de collectivités. Avec un chiffre d’affaires consolidé de plus de CHF 400 millions, c’est l’un des plus grands groupes de restauration en Suisse. Son siège est situé à (VD) et concentre l’ensemble de ses services administratifs qui emploient plus d’une centaine de collaborateurs.***

Afin de compléter notre équipe Ressources Humaines, nous sommes à la recherche d’un :

**Recruteur(se) à 50 %**

Nous vous donnons l’opportunité de rejoindre le leader de la restauration collective en Suisse offrant des conditions de travail attractives à ses collaborateurs ainsi que des couvertures sociales avantageuses.

**Votre rôle**

Intégré au sein de notre équipe Ressources Humaines, vous participez activement au recrutement de nos futurs collaborateurs et accompagnez les responsables de secteur dans le recrutement de nos responsables de restaurant et chefs de cuisine.

Vous prenez en charge les recrutements qui vous sont confiés, depuis la définition du besoin avec les managers jusqu’à la sélection des candidats. Vous rédigez et publiez les annonces sur nos différents canaux, analysez les candidatures reçues, réalisez les premiers entretiens de recrutement.

Vous participez à l’amélioration continue de nos pratiques de recrutement et pouvez être amené à prendre part à différents projets RH au sein du département.

**Votre profil :**

Vous bénéficiez d’une première expérience réussie dans le recrutement, idéalement au sein d’un service RH, d’une agence de placement ou dans un environnement à fort volume. Une bonne connaissance des métiers de la restauration et de leurs enjeux en matière de recrutement est souhaitée.

À l’aise dans la relation avec les candidats et les managers, vous faites preuve d’écoute, de réactivité et d’un excellent sens du service. Organisé, autonome et rigoureux, vous savez gérer plusieurs recrutements simultanément et maîtrisez les outils de recrutement ainsi que les plateformes professionnelles.

Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, et disposez de bonnes connaissances en allemand. Une bonne compréhension du marché de l’emploi suisse ainsi qu’une expérience dans le secteur de la restauration constituent de solides atouts.

**Vous désirez vivre cette belle aventure et êtes intéressé par cette opportunité? Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature complète via le lien ci\-dessous (CV, lettre de motivation et certificats de travail).**

*Afin de promouvoir la diversité et l’inclusion, nous adoptons une politique de recrutement en faveur de l’égalité des chances. Nos postes sont ouverts tant aux femmes qu'aux hommes. Dans cette offre, le genre masculin est utilisé afin d’en faciliter la lecture.*

title: HR Officer
description:
**HR Officer**

**Permanent contract** / Glion, Switzerland

Glion Institute of Higher Education, a Sommet Education Group brand, is a private Swiss institution shaping the future of hospitality and luxury management education across 3 campuses in Glion and Bulle (Switzerland) and London (UK).

3rd in Hospitality and Leisure Management, 3rd in employer reputation in the 2026 QS World University Ranking.

Accredited by the New England Commission of Higher Education (NECHE) and Swiss Accreditation Council (SAC) as a University of Applied Sciences Institute.

Development, Distinctiveness, Joint Commitment, Openness and Sense of Service are the values driving our actions. We offer an innovative, collaborative and thriving environment.

**Responsibilities:**

* Manage the full employee lifecycle administration from onboarding to offboarding, including contracts, amendments, probation follow\-up, employee documentation, work certificates and exit processes
* Maintain accurate HR records and ensure compliance of all employee data, files and HR systems
* Act as the main HR contact for apprentices and trainees, coordinating their administrative journey with schools and apprenticeship authorities
* Provide first\-line HR support and guidance to employees and managers on HR policies, procedures, employee relations and welfare matters
* Support employee relations activities, including conflict resolution, disciplinary actions, warning meetings and termination processes
* Advise employees on payroll, social security, insurance, tax and immigration\-related matters
* Manage recruitment activities, including job postings, candidate screening, interview coordination, reference checks and end\-to\-end recruitment for assigned positions
* Ensure an excellent candidate and hiring manager experience and promote recruitment best practices across the organization
* Coordinate employee engagement, wellbeing initiatives and internal HR communications to foster a positive workplace culture
* Organize employee events and wellbeing activities, including communication, logistics, follow\-up and feedback collection
* Support time and absence management processes, including leave administration, return\-to\-work follow\-up and employee guidance
* Contribute to HR projects, process improvements, HR correspondence, team support activities and provide operational support to the Director of HR


**Profile and experiences:**

* HR Diploma "Certificat d'assistant/e en gestion du personnel" (mandatory), additional degree or certification in HR is an asset
* CFFE diploma (for apprentices' management) would be a plus
* Minimum 3\-5 years of proven HR experience in administration, recruitment, and payroll coordination, ideally in an international or multi\-site environment
* Experience providing employee support/counselling in complex, fast\-evolving environments
* Fluent French \& English (spoken and written)
* Solid knowledge of Swiss employment law, social security, tax and payroll; knowledge of UK legislation is a plus
* Exceptional administrative precision with proven ability to handle high\-volume, detailed tasks without errors
* Strong organisation, prioritisation and time\-management skills, with the ability to independently structure workload and meet deadlines
* Really good command of MS Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and ability to learn HR systems quickly
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a professional, supportive and service\-minded approach
* Demonstrated ability to follow up, close actions, and ensure tasks are completed fully and on time
* Strong understanding of counselling principles, confidentiality, and conflict resolution
* High level of autonomy, accountability and reliability able to work with minimal supervision and anticipate next steps
* Proactive mindset, able to propose improvements and take initiative
* Team player with a collaborative mindset and willingness to support colleagues across tasks and projects


**Other information:**

* Type of contract: undefined period of time contract
* Activity rate: 100%
* Location: weekly presence divided between Glion \& Bulle campuses with home office possibilities

Research Histopathology Technologist
====================================







**Research Histopathology Technologist:** H**istology Laboratory** **/ Cryosectioning / mammalian tissues / fixation, embedding / sectioning / Staining / in vitro samples English**



  **Background:**



The Tissue \& Spatial Technologies Platform in the 360 Labs Initiative is seeking an experienced, highly\-motivated and collaborative histopathology technologist to provide focused histology services and enable user on\-boarding and support for the platform's open lab. The successful candidate will have a robust background in the histological preparation of mammalian tissues and will work as a part of a matrix team, collaborate closely with experts from each of our therapeutic disease areas and functions to advance early drug discovery and participate in the early implementation and growth of the Histopathology Platform within the pRED organization.



  



  **The Perfect Candidate:**



holds a university degree in the life sciences or a laboratory technologist background with at least three years of hands\-on histology experience. They possess exceptional technical skills in handling mammalian and delicate tissues\-such as cryopreserved nervous\-system samples and organoids\-mastering everything from fixation to staining, equipment maintenance, and regulatory assay documentation. Furthermore, they combine strong manual dexterity and detail\-oriented problem\-solving with fluent English communication skills to thrive autonomously in a fast\-paced, collaborative research environment.







  **Tasks \& Responsibilities:**



* Execute end\-to\-end workflows for tissue specimens, including processing, embedding, sectioning, staining (including immunohistochemistry (IHC), in situ hybridization (ISH) and immunofluorescence (IF)) and digital pathology techniques such as whole slide scanning;
* Perform quality control, routine maintenance, and troubleshooting across a range of histology lab instruments to ensure high\-quality data production;
* Provide training and support in the use of histology equipment, and collaborate with laboratory scientists to optimize tissue\-based assays in early drug discovery research projects;
* You embrace a continuous learning mindset by actively engaging with the scientific literature to stay up to date on new technologies/approaches used in the histopathology space.


  



  **Must Haves:**



* You hold a university degree in the life sciences or are a Laboratory Technologist with at least 3 years of histology laboratory experience

Fachspezialist/in Tarifkontrolle und Wirtschaftlichkeitsprüfung – 100%
=========================================================================







**In unserem Team für Tarifkontrolle und Bekämpfung Versicherungsmissbrauch analysierst du das Verhalten von Leistungserbringern, identifizierst Auffälligkeiten bei Kosten\- und Leistungsentwicklungen und leitest daraus konkrete Massnahmen ab. Dabei bewegst du dich an der Schnittstelle von Tarifwesen, Leistungscontrolling, Datenanalyse und Verhandlungen mit Leistungserbringern. Wozu? Um Abweichungen zu erkennen, die Einhaltung der gesetzlichen Grundlagen (KVG/VVG) sicherzustellen und zu einer effizienten Nutzung der Ressourcen beizutragen – bei gleichzeitig konstruktiver Zusammenarbeit mit Leistungserbringern und Partnern.**







  **Was du täglich bewirkst**



* In deiner als Analyst/in und Tarifspezialist/in sammelst und strukturierst du relevante Daten, um fundierte Analysen zu erstellen. Dabei nutzt du die vorhandenen Tools oder holst gezielt zusätzliche Informationen beim zuständigen Fachbereich ein. Auf dieser Grundlage analysierst du die Daten anhand geeigneter Kennzahlen wie Benchmarks, Entwicklungen oder erkennbaren Mustern und leitest daraus gezielte Kontrollen ab. Anschliessend wertest du die Ergebnisse aus, bereitest sie verständlich auf und formulierst konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen.


* Darüber hinaus übernimmst du eine zentrale Koordinationsfunktion: Du kommunizierst deine Analyseergebnisse intern, sorgst für deren Nachvollziehbarkeit und begleitest die Umsetzung definierter Massnahmen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Bereichen – etwa der Rechnungskontrolle, den Verhandlungsteams oder bei der Festlegung von internen Arbeitsanweisungen. Zudem wirkst du aktiv in bereichsübergreifenden Projekten mit.


* Ergänzend dazu führst du Verhandlungen mit Leistungserbringern, insbesondere bei Auffälligkeiten in der Rechnungsstellung. Du steuerst die Gespräche mit dem Ziel, Rückforderungen, Anpassungen der Abrechnungspraxis oder andere geeignete Massnahmen zu erreichen. Bei Bedarf arbeitest du dabei eng mit dem Rechtsdienst zusammen, insbesondere im Hinblick auf mögliche rechtliche Schritte.


**Was du ins Team einbringst**



* Du verfügst über ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und gehst sicher mit Zahlen und Daten um. Komplexe Fragestellungen analysierst du strukturiert, bereitest Ergebnisse verständlich auf und kommunizierst diese adressatengerecht. Selbstständiges Arbeiten sowie ein sicheres Auftreten in Diskussionen und Verhandlungen zählen zu deinen Stärken.
* Du hast eine Ausbildung im Bereich Kranken\-, Sozial\- oder Gesundheitsversicherung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und verfügst über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Gesundheitswesen, idealerweise bei einem Krankenversicherer, einem Spital oder einem Leistungserbringer.
* Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse der Microsoft\-Tools, insbesondere Excel. Erfahrungen mit Power BI oder vergleichbaren Analysewerkzeugen sind von Vorteil.


Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in mindestens einem der folgenden Fachgebiete mit:



* Ambulante Tarife und Tarifstrukturen (insbesondere TARDOC, TARMED oder vergleichbare Tarifwerke)
* Stationäre Leistungen und Spitalcontrolling (z. B. SwissDRG, stationäre Rechnungsprüfung oder Leistungscontrolling)
* Datenanalyse und Controlling (z. B. Auswertung grosser Datenbestände, statistische Analysen oder Business\-Intelligence\-Lösungen)

* 40\-Stunden\-Woche (bei 100%)

Stagiaire R\&D
==============

Dentsply Sirona est le fournisseur principal de produits dentaires professionnels dans le monde. Nos solutions innovantes permettent aux professionnels de la santé bucco\-dentaire de prodiguer des soins plus rapides, plus sûrs et plus efficaces dans tous les domaines de la médecine dentaire. Nous sommes fiers d'être le partenaire privilégié des professionnels, praticiens et chercheurs du secteur dentaire dans le monde entier. Notre siège mondial est situé à York, en Pennsylvanie, et notre siège international à Salzbourg en Autriche. Nos actions sont cotées au NASDAQ avec le symbole XRAY.

**Valoriser le meilleur de nos collaborateurs**

Nos marques permettent aux professionnels dentaires de prodiguer des soins plus rapides, plus sûrs et de meilleure qualité depuis plus de 100 ans. Notre mission consiste à les aider à prodiguer les meilleurs soins dentaires possibles, dans l’intérêt de leurs patients, mais également de l’exercice de leur fonction. Si vous souhaitez évoluer au sein d’une équipe qui façonne le secteur, rejoignez\-nous pour faire partie des meilleurs.

Chez Dentsply Sirona vous:

**Évoluez plus rapidement**\- grâce à notre engagement unique en termes de développement de carrière.

**Devenez plus efficace**\- au sein d’une culture d’entreprise stimulante et valorisant les performances élevées.

**Façonnez le secteur** \- au sein du leader du marché qui favorise en permanence l’innovation.

**Changez les choses** \- en contribuant à l’amélioration de la santé bucco\-dentaire dans le monde entier.

**Stagiaire Temps partiel \- 1 jour/semaine pendant le semestre puis 6 semaines à temps plein. Soit une mission d'environ 7,5 mois**

**Salaire : 1'500 /mois sur une base plein temps**

**Dans le cadre d’un travail de bachelor**, le/la stagiaire R\&D contribue au développement des blocs de test in\-vitro utilisés pour évaluer les performances cliniques des limes endodontiques fabriquées à Ballaigues. La mission consiste à concevoir, fabriquer et caractériser ces blocs en résine époxy et à développer des méthodes de production fiables et répétables répondant aux besoins de tests R\&D avancés (\~1000 blocs/mois). Le/la stagiaire travaille au sein de l’équipe R\&D et en collaboration avec les équipes cliniques, dans le respect des cadres qualité et réglementaires applicables au développement de dispositifs médicaux.

* Concevoir et développer de nouvelles géométries de blocs de test (formes spécifiques aux instruments ou reproduisant un cas clinique).
* Rechercher et évaluer des matériaux dont les propriétés se rapprochent des conditions biologiques.
* Développer et fiabiliser les procédés de fabrication afin d’atteindre une production répétable (\~1000 blocs/mois).
* Caractériser les blocs et valider leurs performances au laboratoire, en collaboration avec les équipes R\&D et cliniques.
* Documenter les méthodes, résultats et recommandations dans le cadre du rapport de travail de bachelor.




**Formation obligatoire en cours de Bachelor ou Master** en science des matériaux, microtechnique, ingénierie ou domaine équivalent.

**Expérience (type et durée) :**

* Aucune expérience professionnelle préalable requise ; premières expériences de laboratoire (travaux pratiques, projets académiques) appréciées.


**Connaissances \& Compétences :**

* Français courant et anglais technique (A2 minimum).
* Notions de science des matériaux et/ou de procédés de fabrication (moulage, résines, usinage).
* Rigueur, autonomie et esprit d’analyse pour le travail de laboratoire et la caractérisation.

**Das darfst Du von uns erwarten**

Der Kontakt zu den Kolleg\*innen ist persönlich und die Entscheidungswege sind kurz. Training Manager
================

**Company Description**

Welcome to Kanadevia Inova, a global innovation leader in the waste infrastructure space, where we believe in creating a sustainable future through technology and innovation.

**Transforming Waste into Value**

At Kanadevia Inova, we pride ourselves on being at the forefront of waste\-to\-X technology. We are not just waste managers; we are creators of value from what communities discard. Your role at Kanadevia Inova directly contributes to turning something once considered useless \- waste \- into something invaluable: energy, heat, hydrogen, fertilizer, and beyond.

**Description**

Are you passionate about turning complex technical knowledge into engaging learning experiences? As our Training Manager, you will develop and deliver comprehensive training solutions for clients operating Waste\-to\-X (WtX), Renewable Gas (RG) and Power\-to\-X (PtX) plants, helping their teams operate and maintain our technologies safely and effectively.

Your responsibilities

* **Manage client training activities from start to finish**, ensuring that the agreed scope, schedule, quality standards and budget are met throughout the project.
* **Develop tailored training concepts and materials**, including interactive learning systems, online content, graphics, animations and project\-specific terminology.
* **Coordinate training delivery with all relevant stakeholders**, including clients, project teams, suppliers, commissioning and operations teams, technical specialists and translation providers.
* **Deliver and supervise classroom, hands\-on training and online training** for shift team leaders, operators and maintenance personnel, including approximately three months of international site travel per year.
* **Drive the continuous improvement of our training solutions** by enhancing training methods and software, supporting tender and budget preparation, developing internal Academy programes and sharing lessons learned across future projects.
**Qualifications**

* **Degree in mechanical, electrical or process engineering**, or a comparable technical qualification, combined with in\-depth knowledge of process engineering.
* **Proven experience in plant operation or commissioning**, ideally gained within interdisciplinary projects in a complex international organisation.
* **Strong training and content\-development experience**, including preparing training concepts and creating clear learning materials using text, graphics, photos and animations.
* **Excellent analytical, communication and organisational skills**, with the ability to explain complex technical topics, motivate participants and coach less\-experienced colleagues.
* **Fluent spoken and written English**, language will be an advantage.
*  **knowledge of MS Office,** particularly Word, Excel and Visio, and a client\-oriented, proactive approach to problem\-solving and decision\-making.

The Tissue \& Spatial Technologies Platform in the 360 Labs Initiative is seeking an experienced, highly\-motivated and collaborative histopathology technologist to provide focused histology services and enable user on\-boarding and support for the platform's open lab. holds a university degree in the life sciences or a laboratory technologist background with at least three years of hands\-on histology experience. The Center for Security Studies (CSS) at ETH Zurich is a center of competence for Swiss and international security policy and peace promotion. It offers expertise in research, teaching, and consultancy.

The Think Tank’s Mediation and Peace Section supports efforts to negotiate, mediate and transform violent political conflicts by conducting research, providing training and directly supporting those engaged in peace practice and conflict transformation processes. We are seeking someone to work as a Program Officer in our “Mediation Support Project” (MSP), a joint project between the CSS ETH Zurich and swisspeace, working in collaboration with the Swiss Federal Department of Foreign Affairs (FDFA). MSP seeks to strengthen Swiss and international mediation efforts.

Aufgaben-/Stellenbeschreibung
The successful candidate will join the Mediation and Peace Team, supporting and leading the implementation of MSP activities. The position will involve the following responsibilities:

Knowledge management and applied research related to mediation in peace processes

Support the operation of mediation networks
Conflict analysis
Support dialogue, negotiation and mediation activities
Work in conflict contexts
Training of future mediators and peace practitioners
Training for parties in conflict contexts (e.g. www.peacemediation.ch, www.mas-mediation.ethz.ch)
Coordination of MSP activities
Organization of MSP activities
Management tasks related to the MSP program

Experience writing, publishing, and editing applied research
Work experience in international organizations, NGOs or think tanks related to the topic of mediation and mediation support
Strong analytical, organizational and interpersonal skills
Curious, cooperative and independent personality
Proactive approach to tasks
Ability to work independently and as part of a team

title: Head Strategic Initiatives & Foresight
description:
Stellentitel
Head Strategic Initiatives & Foresight
Bereich
Office of the President
Einleitungstext
Shape what comes next.

ETH Zurich is looking for an outstanding strategic thinker and leader to head its Strategic Foresight Hub (SFH) within the Office of the President. Leading a small, highly capable team, you will work at the intersection of strategy, foresight, analysis and institutional development – helping ETH Zurich anticipate emerging challenges and opportunities, shape strategic choices, and mobilise expertise to turn strategic thinking into action.

This is a role for someone who enjoys working on complex, cross-cutting and consequential questions, is comfortable operating with incomplete information, and can move seamlessly from analysis and reflection to action. The ideal candidate is agile, thrives in a fast-moving environment, and is able to lead and motivate a small, high-performing team while maintaining a strong strategic focus.

Head Strategic Initiatives & Foresight, 100%, permanent

Aufgaben-/Stellenbeschreibung

As Head of Strategic Initiatives & Foresight, you will lead the SFH and serve as a key strategic partner to the President and ETH Zurich’s leadership.

You will:

Lead strategic initiatives on behalf of the President, addressing complex, cross-cutting or time-critical institutional challenges and opportunities.
Anticipate emerging developments, trends and disruptions and assess their implications for ETH Zurich.
Shape strategic options, priorities and decision-making by developing analyses, scenarios, strategic briefs and actionable recommendations.
Mobilise expertise from across ETH Zurich and beyond, assembling and coordinating temporary, purpose-driven task forces when required.
Design and lead strategic planning processes at the institutional level and support strategic planning at the level of the Departments, Centres and other units.
Advise the President and the Executive Board on the scoping and delivery of strategic projects, providing strategic, analytical and coordination support.
Develop and apply foresight methods, strategic frameworks and collaborative approaches to support long-term institutional thinking and decision-making.
Build and maintain an interdisciplinary community of future-oriented thinkers across ETH Zurich, including the Foresight Champions network.
Develop and facilitate strategic workshops, foresight initiatives and leadership dialogues for the President, the Executive Board and the broader ETH community.
Strengthen ETH Zurich’s strategic foresight capability and culture and contribute to its future-oriented thought leadership and institutional positioning.
Lead, develop and inspire a small, high-performing team within the Office of the President.
Depending on the nature of an assignment, you will move between different roles: strategist, analyst, facilitator, convener and orchestrator. You will not necessarily provide all the expertise required to solve a problem yourself; rather, you will know how to identify the right expertise, bring people together, structure the problem, create a productive process, and turn diverse perspectives into clear options and actionable outcomes.

Ihr Profil

We are looking for an intellectually curious, strategically minded and highly accomplished professional who combines analytical depth with sound judgement and a strong bias towards action.

You have:

A university degree, preferably at doctoral level, in a relevant field such as social sciences, economics, political science, science and technology, engineering, or a related discipline.
Several years of professional experience in strategy, strategic planning, foresight, policy, management consulting, research, innovation, task forces or a comparable field.
A proven ability to understand complex issues quickly, identify what matters, structure ambiguity and develop clear, evidence-based recommendations.
Strong analytical and conceptual skills, combined with the ability to translate complex information into concise and compelling decision-making material.
Experience in leading strategic projects and multidisciplinary teams, preferably in an international and intellectually demanding environment.
A demonstrated ability to work effectively with senior leaders and diverse stakeholders, including academics, experts, institutional leaders and external partners.
Excellent facilitation, communication and presentation skills, with outstanding written and verbal English; proficiency in German is an advantage.
The confidence and agility to operate in situations where the questions are not yet clearly defined and where speed, discretion and sound judgement are essential.
A collaborative and entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to build trust, mobilise people and get things done across organisational boundaries.
A genuine interest in science, technology and the societal forces shaping the future, and in the role of a leading university in addressing complex global challenges.

Wir bieten

You will join the Office of the President of ETH Zurich at a particularly important moment in the institution's development. Working in close proximity to the President and the Executive Board, you will have the opportunity to engage with some of the most consequential strategic questions facing one of the world's leading universities.

You will lead a small team with a broad mandate and considerable autonomy, while drawing on the exceptional expertise of ETH Zurich's faculty, staff and international network.

The role offers a unique combination of strategic proximity, intellectual breadth, institutional impact and the opportunity to shape what comes next.

Motivation letter
CV
Job references and diplomas

title: Global Merchandising Head Of Lifestyle & Special Projects
description:
In short
As the Global Merchandising Head Of Lifestyle & Special Projects, you will shape and drive the Global Merchandising strategy across On’s Lifestyle portfolio, spanning both Lifestyle Footwear and Special Projects across Footwear, Apparel and Accessories.
You will own the global range architecture, consumer proposition and tailored assortments, ensuring On delivers the right product, to the right consumer, in the right channel, at the right time and at the right price.
At the heart of this role is creating consumer desirability and brand heat while building a sustainable and scalable Lifestyle business. You will translate On’s global brand and product strategy into compelling assortments that balance commercial performance with premium brand positioning.
You will bring a strong point of view on consumer, product, channel and market opportunity, influencing product briefs and franchise strategies from the earliest stages of development through to seasonal execution and sell-through.
For Special Projects, you will apply the same commercial and consumer lens to build high-impact, culturally relevant and strategically important product stories, using controlled distribution, scarcity and tailored assortments to create demand and strengthen On’s premium positioning.
You will partner closely with Product, Design, Innovation, Brand, Regional Merchandising, Partnership Management, VM and Global and Regional Sales to ensure consumer and market insights translate into differentiated product strategies, global range architecture and commercially successful assortments.

Your mission
Build the Global Lifestyle Merchandising Strategy
- Define and evolve the global merchandising strategy for Lifestyle and Special Projects, translating On’s broader brand and product priorities into clear consumer and commercial strategies.
- Build the global range architecture ensuring an efficient yet compelling Lifestyle proposition.
- Identify opportunities to expand Lifestyle into new consumer segments, channels and categories while protecting On’s premium positioning.
- Develop clear merchandising frameworks that balance consumer desirability, brand heat, commercial opportunity and sustainable profitability.

Drive Product & Franchise Strategy
- Influence product briefs and franchise strategies from concept through to commercialization, ensuring products are rooted in clear consumer and market opportunities.
- Establish clear roles for hero, core, growth and incubation franchises, ensuring the portfolio evolves with consumer demand.
- Identify when franchises should be scaled, reset, repositioned or exited based on consumer and commercial signals.

Own Global Range & Assortment Excellence
- Build seasonal range plans across Lifestyle and Special Projects, translating global strategy into detailed SKU-level line plans.
- Build consumer-right tailored channel assortments globally, balancing global consistency with regional and account-specific opportunities.
- Provide a clear point of view on product flow, colour needs, depth, price and channel distribution to maximize seasonal performance.
- Ensure global and regional teams are aligned on the range strategy while allowing appropriate market localization.

Lead Special Projects
- Own the global merchandising strategy for Special Projects, working project-by-project to define the consumer proposition, range, targets, distribution and commercial strategy.
- Develop clear scarcity and allocation frameworks to balance brand heat with commercial opportunity.
- Partner closely with Product, Design and Brand to bring strategically important innovations and collaborations to market.
- Ensure Special Projects acts as an incubator for future Lifestyle franchises, consumer insights and new business opportunities.
- Set sell-through, volume, NS and productivity targets and ensure the range is structured to deliver against them.

Drive Commercial Performance
- Own global seasonal targets and commercial KPIs across Lifestyle and Special Projects.
- Identify commercial risks and opportunities early and drive cross-functional actions to address them.
- Use performance data, consumer signals and market intelligence to continuously refine the global range strategy.

Your story
- 8+ years of experience within premium sportswear, luxury fashion or streetwear with significant experience owning global or multi-market businesses.
- Strong people leader with the ability to build, develop and inspire a high-performing global merchandising team.
- Proven track record of building global merchandising strategies and commercial plans across multiple channels and markets.
- Deep understanding of Lifestyle and sneaker culture, with a strong instinct for what will create consumer relevance and brand heat.
- Commercially strong, with the ability to balance brand aspiration, consumer desirability and financial performance.
- Highly comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed global environment, with strong executive presence and the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
- A strategic thinker who can move seamlessly between 5-year vision and SKU-level detail.
- Exceptional relationship builder who can connect Product, Design, Innovation, Brand, Merchandising, Sales and Regional teams around a common consumer and commercial ambition.
- A resilient, entrepreneurial leader who thrives in ambiguity, embraces change and proactively builds solutions in a high-growth environment.
- Data-led but consumer obsessed, able to combine quantitative insights with strong product and cultural intuition.

Meet the team
On’s Global Merchandising Team sits at the center of Product, Brand and Commercial Strategy, ensuring we create and deliver the right product to the right consumer, in the right market, at the right time and at the right scale.
As the Global Merchandising Head of Lifestyle (Inline) & Special Projects, you will lead the merchandising strategy for one of On’s key future growth opportunities, working across global and regional teams to build a consumer-led, commercially sustainable and culturally relevant Lifestyle business.
You will be a key voice in shaping not only what we sell, but where On plays, how we build demand and how we scale the Lifestyle business globally

Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – Asset & Wealth Management (100%)

Pfäffikon SZ, Switzerland

About the Company:

We are an internationally focused Swiss asset management company based in the Canton of Schwyz. As an asset manager within the meaning of the Swiss Financial Institutions Act (FinIA), we provide our clients with asset management, financial advisory and related financial services.
We operate in an international environment and act both on our own account and on behalf of third parties. In doing so, we combine financial expertise with an entrepreneurial approach to identifying and developing investment opportunities.
As we enter the next phase of our corporate development, we are seeking an accomplished and internationally experienced Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead the company, strengthen the ex-isting business and drive strategic expansion into new markets and investment sectors, with a pri-mary focus on Life Sciences (particularly artificial intelligence) and international markets – with an emphasis on the United Kingdom, Asia and Eastern Europe.

Your Role:

As CEO, you will have overall responsibility for the strategic, operational and commercial develop-ment of the company. Working closely with the Board of Directors, shareholders and other senior stakeholders, you will define and implement the corporate strategy and lead the continued devel-opment of the company as an internationally focused Swiss asset manager.
You will combine strong leadership and investment expertise with entrepreneurial thinking, exten-sive transaction experience and a deep understanding of international financial markets.
How You Will Contribute to Our Success
•    Assume overall responsibility for the strategic, operational and commercial management of the company and translate its long-term vision into measurable business objectives.
•    Identify, assess and develop new markets, with a focus on the United Kingdom, Asia and East-ern Europe, as well as investment opportunities and strategic partnerships in the Life Sciences sector (particularly artificial intelligence).
•    Drive fundraising initiatives and further expand the company’s international investor and busi-ness network, particularly in the United Kingdom, Asia and Eastern Europe, within the aforemen-tioned financial sectors.
•    Lead and oversee investment activities across asset and portfolio management, corporate fi-nance, M&A, private equity and fundraising.
•    Lead, develop and support the management team and employees, while establishing a culture of excellence, accountability, integrity and entrepreneurial thinking.

Requirements:

•    A university degree with excellent academic results from a top-tier university in Life Science Entrepreneurship.
•    Strong industry knowledge and relevant professional experience in Life Sciences and AI, in-cluding the ability to assess companies, technologies, markets and investment opportunities in these sectors.
•    Several years of international leadership experience in the financial sector, ideally in asset or wealth management, investment management, private equity, corporate finance, investment banking or a comparable environment.
•    A proven track record in several of the following areas: corporate finance and financial analy-sis, M&A and transaction execution, fundraising, private equity, portfolio management and investment management, with a particular focus on Life Sciences (especially artificial intel-ligence).
•    A demonstrated ability to identify and develop new markets and business opportunities and to translate strategic opportunities into sustainable commercial growth – preferably with leader-ship experience in Asia and the United Kingdom.
•    Excellent communication, representation and negotiation skills, together with the ability to build trusted relationships with boards of directors, shareholders, investors, clients and other senior stakeholders.
•    A high degree of integrity, discretion, resilience and sound judgement, including when handling confidential information and complex decisions.
•    Languages: English and Russian.
•    Willingness to be based in Switzerland for this role.

What We Offer:

•    A top-level executive position with overall responsibility for an internationally focused Swiss as-set management company.
•    The opportunity to play a significant role in shaping the company’s strategic direction and to lead it through its next phase of growth and international development.
•    A central role in expanding the company’s activities in some of the most dynamic investment sectors, particularly Life Sciences (artificial intelligence).
•    A high degree of responsibility and autonomy in developing new markets, investment opportuni-ties and strategic partnerships in the aforementioned area, particularly in the United Kingdom, Asia and Eastern Europe.
•    Close collaboration with the Board of Directors, shareholders, investors and senior stakeholders across the Swiss and international financial ecosystem.
•    A professional, ethical and performance-oriented working environment that encourages initiative, accountability and long-term professional development.

Interested?

If you are an internationally experienced financial services executive with a strong investment and transaction background and the ambition to help shape the future of an entrepreneurial asset man-agement company, we look forward to hearing from you.

We look forward to receiving your application, including your CV and relevant supporting docu-ments, by email to:

Markus Marthaler

Product Specialist Aftermarket (m/f/x)

Your Responsibilities

* You manage related operational work packages from concept clarification through pilot implementation to final handover
* You maintain documentation, implementation status, open points, risks, decisions and escalation needs for assigned product initiatives

* You are fluent in German and/or French, and you possess very good English skills
* You are distinguished by strong ability to understand technical systems and translate findings into structured product and process requirements
